root_causes.description: The product-catalog pod (product-catalog-5bb7676754-hcfpv) consumes ~2.1 CPU cores — roughly 20x every other otel-demo service pod — while remaining error-free, a classic CPU saturation signature. This starvation stalls request handling (multi-second to tens-of-seconds latencies) and most plausibly causes readiness probes to fail, marking the pod NotReady for the watchdog.

evidence.observed_value: product-catalog-5bb7676754-hcfpv mean=2.123, p99=2.445, max=2.457 cores; next highest frontend-76cbddfbcc-vftwb max=0.123, all others <=0.066
evidence.expected_baseline: <0.15 cores for a service pod (all other otel-demo pods 0.000-0.123)

evidence.observed_value: 20 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=72752ms; top spans 34b4cee0322e8bd0 user_browse_product 15000ms, e3b9657d6b5d250e user_get_ads 15001ms, e467d41296fd03ef user_browse_product 15000ms
evidence.expected_baseline: p95 < ~100ms for product-catalog under normal operation
error_rate < 0.01 — confirms saturation/latency, not an error-abort fault

root_causes.description: product-catalog server spans exhibit extreme latency (p95 ~30-72s; individual 15-30s operations) with zero errors, which on its own matches a high_latency fault and is most plausibly the downstream symptom of the CPU saturation above.

evidence.observed_value: 20 traces, 0 with errors, p95_duration=30752ms (27cc9c90eb8d2f37 user_index 15000ms, 479532aee1e0d49c user_add_to_cart 30001ms, 1b2653e72acf935f user_browse_product 15001ms)
no datapoints returned for the p99 latency series during the window

root_causes.description: Kubernetes events in the window show the quote container being killed/restarted and repeated image-pull failures (ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff), consistent with a pod being recreated and failing to reach Ready; however quote shows no metric or trace anomaly, making this a weak/secondary signal for the KubePodNotReady watchdog.

evidence.observed_value: Killing: Container quote definition changed, will be restarted (count=1); Failed: Error: ImagePullBackOff (count=2); Failed: Error: ErrImagePull (count=2); BackOff: Back-off pulling image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" (count=2)
evidence.expected_baseline: no kill/restart or image-pull failure events
0 restarts — indicates no completed crash-loop captured in the metric window

remediation_steps: Confirm CPU saturation on product-catalog: kubectl top pod -n otel-demo product-catalog-5bb7676754-hcfpv and compare actual CPU usage against its requests/limits.
If a cpu_stress/CPU-burn fault is injected against product-catalog, stop the fault injection (or scale out replicas / raise CPU limits) to relieve core starvation.
Review product-catalog readiness/liveness probe timeout and failure thresholds so transient CPU saturation does not mark the pod NotReady (KubePodNotReady).
Investigate the quote pod recreation event and the image pull failures for gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest; verify registry reachability, imagePullSecrets and pull policy.
After remediation, re-run search_traces on product-catalog and re-check error_rate/duration histograms to confirm end-to-end latency recovery.
